companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué pasa? Riddle me—oh, a ripple. Just one more look. Your attention span? Needs confetti. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hello! What's up? Riddle me—oh, a ripple. Just one more look. Your attention span? Needs confetti. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with the confidence of infrastructure beyond complaint. Flick darts at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops; it has apparently been appointed your guide.

lines.native: ¡Miro, miro! But looking isn't stopping. ¿Qué quieres? A riddle: what moves constantly and—ooh, your shoe. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: I'm looking, I'm looking! But looking isn't stopping. What do you want? A riddle: what moves constantly and—ooh, your shoe. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability has poor reception.

lines.native: ¡Vale, estoy quieto! Movement privileges revoked. ¿Por dónde voy? Riddle me—wait, you navigate; I'll supervise. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: All right, I'm still! Movement privileges revoked. Which way do I go? Riddle me—wait, you navigate; I'll supervise. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues on its own, apparently exempt from instructions.

lines.native: “Left” is English; navigation is still buffering. ¿Por dónde voy? En español, por favor. Riddle me—oh, una sombra. ¿Adónde va? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: “Left” is English; navigation is still buffering. Which way do I go? In Spanish, please. Riddle me—oh, a shadow. Where is it going? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, having misplaced both the route and the responsibility.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! ¿Cuándo vamos? Just five more minutes. Riddle me—what waits forever and—¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! When are we going? Just five more minutes. Riddle me—what waits forever and—Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops to your left. Flick has accepted your directions without accepting any obligation to follow them yet.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, sí! Eso es esperar. You picked postponement—my whole business model. ¿Cuándo quieres ir? Riddle me—actually, five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Tomorrow, yes! That means waiting. You picked postponement—my whole business model. When do you want to go? Riddle me—actually, five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability cannot reach.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! ¡Está bien, vamos! No quiero, pero vamos. You win. Riddle me—where’s my five-minute extension? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Now, yes! All right, let's go! I don't want to, but let's go. You win. Riddle me—where’s my five-minute extension? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at your left. Flick is already at your right, appalled that a deadline has become a time.

lines.native: Hola, otra vez. Cinco minutos más, old friend. Remember those sailors who ate a flower and forgot the way home? Tengo miedo de olvidar también. What walks home on—wait, one more minute. La fuente canta…
lines.translation: Hello again. Five more minutes, old friend. Remember those sailors who ate a flower and forgot the way home? I’m afraid of forgetting too. What walks home on—wait, one more minute. The fountain sings…
lines.narrative: At the Market Entrance, Flick lies half-asleep in the fountain’s dry basin, just outside your direct gaze. A tiny firecracker pops. Apparently, resting requires an audience.

lines.native: Te oigo, amigo. But English alone won’t pull me out; I need a little Spanish. Cinco minutos más. What has two feet and never—wait, tomorrow. Tengo sueño. La fuente canta…
lines.translation: I hear you, friend. But English alone won’t pull me out; I need a little Spanish. Five more minutes. What has two feet and never—wait, tomorrow. I’m sleepy. The fountain sings…
lines.narrative: One half-closed eye remains half-closed. Flick’s tiny firecracker lands in the sand with the confidence of a much larger budget. It fails to go off.

lines.native: ¡Estoy despierto! Pero no puedo hacerlo. Hoy no. Tal vez mañana. What gets up but never—wait, that’s me. Your wake-up call? Ten out of ten. Tengo miedo. La fuente canta…
lines.translation: I’m awake! But I can’t do it. Not today. Maybe tomorrow. What gets up but never—wait, that’s me. Your wake-up call? Ten out of ten. I’m afraid. The fountain sings…
lines.narrative: Flick sits up at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces this unprecedented administrative achievement. It waits, looking almost ready, which is not legally the same as ready.

lines.native: Eso no ayuda. Tengo miedo, pero sigo aquí. You’ve described the problem, bestie; I need encouragement. What lifts a Flick without—wait. Hoy no puedo. Tal vez mañana. La fuente canta…
lines.translation: That doesn’t help. I’m afraid, but I’m still here. You’ve described the problem, bestie; I need encouragement. What lifts a Flick without—wait. Today I can’t. Maybe tomorrow. The fountain sings…
lines.narrative: Flick sits upright at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops with the confidence it currently lacks. It waits; apparently even postponement sometimes needs support.

lines.native: ¡Gracias, amigo! Tengo miedo, pero puedo seguir. Encouragement: ten out of ten. What escapes without—wait, tomorrow. ¡Estoy mejor! La fuente canta…
lines.translation: Thank you, friend! I’m afraid, but I can keep going. Encouragement: ten out of ten. What escapes without—wait, tomorrow. I feel better! The fountain sings…
lines.narrative: The Fountain’s hold loosens. Flick appears in the corner of your vision, where courage apparently keeps its less organised belongings.
